preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 50,000 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 150,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each value ai in the list a is between 0 and n inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices u and v, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two vertices u and v, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(u == v or u in ancestors[v] for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query (u, v), u is an ancestor of v or u equals v.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of queries q.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= answer <= n for answer in output)
postconditions.description: Each answer is between 0 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == max(ai ^ dist(i, v) for i in path[u][v]) for answer, (u, v) in zip(output, queries))
postconditions.description: Each answer is the maximum value of ai XOR dist(i, v) for all vertices i on the path from u to v.
